svg.title: Eight Specialization Classes — Measured Gains
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart comparing instruction, VALU, and SALU reduction ratios across eight specialization classes, with annotations for scalar instruction deletion, the S2 register-pressure tradeoff, and the intentionally retained S7 negative result.
svg.text: interpreter → specialized, same op, same operands · ratios, higher is better
Data-dependent; there is nothing to fold.
spread is 5.50× to 1.02× — specialization is not a uniform multiplier;
All three counters fall in all eight cases. The mechanism is deletion, not substitution — confirmed at corpus scale on 26 of 26 circuits (§14.3).
